command_line:
set -eu
cat > deseq2_deg.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
counts_path <- args[[1]]
layout_path <- args[[2]]
map_path <- args[[3]]

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))

counts <- read.csv(counts_path, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
layout <- read.csv(layout_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
map <- read.delim(map_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

if (!all(c("SampleID", "Group") %in% colnames(layout))) {
  stop("sample layout must contain SampleID and Group")
}
layout$matrix_sample <- gsub("-", "_", layout$SampleID, fixed = FALSE)
missing <- setdiff(layout$matrix_sample, colnames(counts))
if (length(missing) > 0) {
  stop(paste("sample IDs not found in count matrix:", paste(missing, collapse = ",")))
}
layout <- layout[match(colnames(counts), layout$matrix_sample), , drop = FALSE]
if (any(is.na(layout$SampleID))) {
  stop("count matrix columns could not all be matched to layout")
}
if (!("DMSO" %in% layout$Group) || !("Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50" %in% layout$Group)) {
  stop("required contrast levels are absent")
}

count_mat <- as.matrix(counts)
storage.mode(count_mat) <- "integer"
coldata <- data.frame(Group = factor(layout$Group), row.names = colnames(count_mat))
coldata$Group <- relevel(coldata$Group, ref = "DMSO")

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = count_mat, colData = coldata, design = ~ Group)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("Group", "Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50", "DMSO"), alpha = 0.05)
resdf <- as.data.frame(res)
resdf$ENSG <- rownames(resdf)
resdf <- resdf[, c("ENSG", setdiff(colnames(resdf), "ENSG"))]

names(map)[1:2] <- c("ENSG", "gene_name")
res_annot <- merge(resdf, map[, c("ENSG", "gene_name")], by = "ENSG", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
sig <- res_annot[!is.na(res_annot$padj) & res_annot$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(res_annot$log2FoldChange) & abs(res_annot$log2FoldChange) >= 0.5, , drop = FALSE]
sig <- sig[!is.na(sig$gene_name) & sig$gene_name != "", , drop = FALSE]
sig_symbols <- unique(sig$gene_name)

universe <- merge(data.frame(ENSG = rownames(count_mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE), map[, c("ENSG", "gene_name")], by = "ENSG", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
universe_symbols <- unique(universe$gene_name[!is.na(universe$gene_name) & universe$gene_name != ""])

write.table(res_annot, "deseq2_annotated_results.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
writeLines(sig_symbols, "deg_symbols.txt")
writeLines(universe_symbols, "background_symbols.txt")
summary <- data.frame(
  metric = c("samples", "genes", "mapped_sig_deg_symbols", "mapped_background_symbols"),
  value = c(ncol(count_mat), nrow(count_mat), length(sig_symbols), length(universe_symbols))
)
write.table(summary, "summary.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
